nom: Peach Slices Scar Remedy Silicone Sheets

avis.texte: Product does not stick to the skin at all. It only lasts like 3 hours before it starts to fall off. I also have not noticed a difference in my scars (2 weeks).

I bought these for my spouse who had a small mild burn on her forearm from cooking. After the burn began to heal over, she started wearing a silicone sheet on the area on a regular basis. It really seems to have helped speed up the healing and the scar seems to be fading already. I'm also impressed by the re-usability of each sheet - it still sicks well even after wearing and washing it multiple times.
It's very comfortable on the skin while it stays on pretty well. almost forgot I had it on! Loved that it applies like a band-aid style. Very sanitizing and easy to use. would use and recommend!
Even when following directions, the sheets do not stick at all. They fall off after sboit 5 minutes. Will be returning do not waste your money on these
They wont even stick. And not curve friendly, wont even stay for 5 mins

These strips do not stick. When I first put it on, the strip fell off within the first few minutes. I rinsed it with warm water to get it adhesive again and went to bed, then it came off again when I was sleeping. I love the products from this brand but this does not work.

These are such a cool idea - just need a few tweaks! I used these daily for a week and a half after removing the waterproof bandage over my c-section scar. They felt protective and soothing, and kept the scar area clean without needing to apply bandages. The reason I stopped using them was that I ran out much faster than the box implies - because when I tried to wash them for reuse, they curled up into very tight cylinders and stuck to themselves. This happened whether or not I used a tiny bit of soap (I used pH-balanced foaming facewash) or just water, and it happened whether or not I used cold or warm water. If I managed to uncurl them they wouldn't stick to my skin barely at all. I didn't feel safe reusing them without washing, so I would just open a new patch. All that being said, I still think this is a really cool product and I'm a very big fan of the scar gel in this line as well!
I put this on completely dry skin on my chin and it does not l stay on at all

This literally stuck to my skin for about 2 minutes max, until I moved and the edges lifted and would not stay down no matter what I did. I rinsed it off to try to reactivate it and the whole patch curled up into itself. Returned it immediately, don't waste your time. use the gel from peach slices instead, that works so far
It works well and stays on good, but if you plan on doing work out side and it has not been freshly put on, it will start to come off and get really dirty.
Wanted to try a new product and liked the idea that they could be reused. But upon use, immediately began to lift. Came off in the middle of the night and crumpled.
